reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Mississippi
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: "Is it specified what is required to be in the notice?"
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario (factual statement)
   ========================= */

% The user-provided context.
scenario_state(mississippi).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The user's question is about whether the law specifies required notice contents.
question_about(notice_required_contents).

% Helper predicate that succeeds exactly when the encoded scenario holds.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(mississippi),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    question_about(notice_required_contents).

/* =========================
   Statute translation
   MS Code  89-8-13 (2020)
   ========================= */

% Treat the 2020 statute text as applicable to the focus year 2021 for this encoding.
statute_in_force(ms_code_89_8_13, mississippi, 2021).

/*
  MS Code  89-8-13(3) (2020): For material noncompliance (general breach),
  the notice must specify:
    - the acts and omissions constituting the breach, and
    - that the rental agreement will terminate on a date not less than 14 days after receipt
      if the breach is not remedied within a reasonable time not in excess of 14 days.
*/
statute_notice_required_element(ms_code_89_8_13, material_noncompliance_general, specify_acts_and_omissions_constituting_breach).
statute_notice_required_element(ms_code_89_8_13, material_noncompliance_general, specify_termination_upon_date_not_less_than_14_days_after_receipt_if_not_cured).
statute_notice_required_element(ms_code_89_8_13, material_noncompliance_general, specify_cure_time_reasonable_not_exceeding_14_days).

/*
  MS Code  89-8-13(3) (2020): For recurring substantially same noncompliance within six months,
  the notice must specify:
    - the breach, and
    - the date of termination of the rental agreement.
*/
statute_notice_required_element(ms_code_89_8_13, repeat_noncompliance_within_6_months, specify_the_breach).
statute_notice_required_element(ms_code_89_8_13, repeat_noncompliance_within_6_months, specify_termination_date).

/* =========================
   Reasoning helpers
   ========================= */

% The statute "specifies what is required to be in the notice" if it imposes at least one
% required notice element for some covered situation.
statute_specifies_notice_required_contents(State, Year) :-
    statute_in_force(ms_code_89_8_13, State, Year),
    statute_notice_required_element(ms_code_89_8_13, _Situation, _Element),
    !.

/* =========================
   Final answer
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    statute_specifies_notice_required_contents(State, Year),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

/* =========================
   Main entrypoint
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it specified what is required to be in the notice?
